title: Chinese EV Makers’ European Offensive

Chinese EV Makers’ European Offensive

AJ Cortese

Gavekal Technologies: New Energy | 28 Sep 2026

Chinese EV makers have conquered their home market and are on track to export over 5mn vehicles this year, double the 2025 figure. Their next move will be to start moving production offshore, to get closer to key markets and evade tariffs. The biggest target is Europe, where half a dozen projects are under way and many more are planned. Chinese EV makers may ramp up European production far more rapidly than Japanese carmakers did in North America four decades ago, in part because they are often taking over existing plants rather than building new ones.
